# Trust Tai

> Consultancy and AI agency that maps the journey from where a founder-led business is today to the position it could own in a decade, then builds the first leg.

Trust Tai works with founder-led businesses to produce a Business Operating Roadmap: a living plan from Point A (how the business runs today) to Point B (a defined 24-month destination) toward Point C (the ten-year position). We then build the milestones the roadmap calls for — websites, CRMs, operating dashboards, learning platforms, AI assistants, workflow automation, and the connective operating layer.

- [Investment](/investment): Pacing tiers (Accelerated, Balanced, Steady) and what each includes.
- [About](/about): Tai Shobajo and the thesis behind Trust Tai.
